hero_sub: From architectural design to project completion — we deliver innovative, quality construction solutions for residential, commercial and institutional clients across Kenya.
about_para1: We are a multidisciplinary construction and design company specializing in architectural design, design-and-build solutions, roofing services, and project management. From concept development to project completion, we provide integrated solutions that ensure quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness at every stage.
about_para2: Our team is committed to delivering projects that meet the highest standards of craftsmanship while exceeding our clients' expectations through innovation, transparency, and attention to detail.
mission: To provide innovative architectural, construction, roofing, and project management solutions that deliver exceptional quality, value, and client satisfaction through professionalism, integrity, and excellence.
vision: To be the preferred design and construction partner, transforming ideas into sustainable, functional, and inspiring spaces while setting the benchmark for quality and innovation.
leadership_bio: Our Director leads Prepegola Builders Limited with hands-on experience across residential, commercial and coastal projects. From reinforcement and formwork to final finishes, he personally oversees quality on every build — bringing the discipline, safety culture and attention to detail that define our work.
leadership_points: Over a decade of on-site construction leadership.
Personally supervises structural works and handover.
Direct line to clients — no middlemen, no surprises.
